findings.claim: A second export without --force replaces the first file instead of refusing.
findings.evidence:
$ export --out out
wrote out/export.json
$ export --out out
wrote out/export.json
exit status 0

subclaims.text: The second export writes out/export.json again.
subclaims.quote:
$ export --out out
wrote out/export.json
exit status 0

subclaims.text: The second export exits 0 instead of 3.

findings.claim: The --force export loses the records added since the first export.

subclaims.text: The --force export writes only three records.

findings.claim: The refusal message is printed to stdout instead of stderr.
subclaims: The refusal message is still visible when stderr is discarded.
